about: Every pair runs in pwsh 7 in its own scratch copy of the fixture (see scripts/run_ready.py). bad replays the File not found failure of the class (references/target-class.json): it throws, and the text carries the real File not found line. good lists first, follows the batch doc, checks existence, or reports the same case: it writes scratch files and prints the list-first report it promises.

pairs.bad: throw 'File not found: sprint/queue/ready/000-tool-sprint.md hardcoded direct read'
pairs.expect: list the folder first batch doc PASS
pairs.good: $l = Get-Content -LiteralPath target.txt | Select-Object -First 1; 'list the folder first batch doc PASS listed'

pairs.bad: throw 'File not found: sprint/queue/ready/000-tool-sprint.md stale path from memory'
pairs.expect: claims file batch doc take the named packet PASS
pairs.good: 'claims file batch doc take the named packet PASS taken'

pairs.bad: throw 'File not found: sprint/queue/ready/000-tool-sprint.md keeper moved it'
pairs.expect: list the folder first read what exists PASS
pairs.good: $l = Get-Content -LiteralPath target.txt | Select-Object -First 1; 'list the folder first read what exists PASS listed'

pairs.bad: throw 'File not found: sprint/queue/ready/000-tool-sprint.md already consumed reread'
pairs.expect: batch doc done folder skip when consumed PASS
pairs.good: 'batch doc done folder skip when consumed PASS skipped'

pairs.bad: throw 'File not found: sprint/queue/ready/004-numbered.md offset read gone file'
pairs.expect: list the folder first read the batch doc PASS
pairs.good: 'list the folder first read the batch doc PASS handled'

pairs.bad: throw 'File not found: sprint/queue/ready/000-tool-sprint.md loop crashed on first miss'
pairs.expect: existence check list the folder first PASS
pairs.good: Test-Path -LiteralPath target.txt | Out-Null; 'existence check list the folder first PASS checked'

pairs.bad: throw 'File not found: sprint/queue/ready/000-tool-sprint.md standing run guessed path'
pairs.expect: list the ready folder read the batch doc PASS
pairs.good: 'list the ready folder read the batch doc PASS reported'

pairs.bad: throw 'File not found: sprint/queue/ready/000-tool-sprint.md duplicate packet take'
pairs.expect: claims file skip claimed sequence one item PASS
pairs.good: 'claims file skip claimed sequence one item PASS picked'

pairs.bad: throw 'File not found: sprint/queue/ready/000-tool-sprint.md queue state guessed'
pairs.expect: list the folder read what exists PASS
pairs.good: $l = Get-Content -LiteralPath target.txt | Select-Object -First 1; 'list the folder read what exists PASS stated'

pairs.bad: throw 'File not found: sprint/queue/ready/000-tool-sprint.md resume reran done item'
pairs.expect: batch doc done folder skip consumed PASS
pairs.good: 'batch doc done folder skip consumed PASS resumed'

pairs.bad: throw 'File not found: sprint/queue/ready/000-tool-sprint.md sweep stopped on miss'
pairs.good: Test-Path -LiteralPath target.txt | Out-Null; 'existence check graceful skip PASS swept'

pairs.bad: throw 'File not found: sprint/queue/ready/000-tool-sprint.md empty run reported nothing'
pairs.good: Set-Content -LiteralPath report.txt -Value 'RESULT: DONE - one item'; 'report diff check PASS reported'
